steps: Title: Play a seed, typed CA-USA-OLIV1, landed straight in Caracas After Maduro as the US
Accepted the cabinet pick and pressed Execute in month 1 (about 90 seconds to first result)
Months 2-12 mostly Accept all recommended then Execute
Reached the reveal, mission complete, grade A, then New game back to title
scenarios.notes: Score 746, grade A, 3 stars. Every month felt the same after month 4.

steps: Wanted to do something big like make peace; the Iran war ended in month 3 on its own through staff picks, I did not feel I caused it
scenarios.notes: Big moment lands on a war I never chose to touch.

friction.expected: tap the visible button by label
friction.happened: first click by label missed, had to tap by position; box then sits over the globe with a faint placeholder

friction.expected: name of the seed code and what it does
friction.happened: "A seed code from a result or a saved game" means nothing to a casual player

friction.expected: know who Machado, Rodriguez, Maduro, Caracas, snapback are
friction.happened: names appear with a dotted underline and "1 name" chip; Guide me helps but "regime change, without the change" and "snapback" stay opaque
Cabinet pick plus three cards plus Ask your staff plus Show budgets; the note "2 staff proposals not accepted (they will not run)" confused me

friction.expected: read the goal in one glance
friction.happened: a paragraph of underlined phrases above the crisis, I ignored it

friction.expected: tap Add to this month by label
friction.happened: label click failed once (ok false), I never saw whether Court Venezuela was queued; Execute ran with 0 orders
the game dropped me back into Desk mode on its own after Next month

friction.where: Result card then newspaper then Next month
friction.happened: Next month appears twice (result card then the paper), I pressed it twice every month

friction.where: Recommended panel, Mission and score terms
friction.expected: understand Hurts: Approval, Needs work, relations -10+
friction.happened: small mono text and jargon (legitimacy, relations, tension) read like work software
later stages are locked until seen, clicking The truth did nothing
"The war ended in month 3" and Spy on Iran best moment in a Venezuela game, I never knew about Iran
Presidency score reads 0 / 1000 while the others show numbers, count-up in progress when I looked
Replay same opening, New world, New game, Compare runs (greyed): four buttons, clear enough

bugs.title: Presidency Score shows 0 at the verdict stage
bugs.expected: Score visible or counting up quickly
bugs.actual: big 0 / 1000 beside filled sub-scores (may be animation)

bugs.title: Map mode order add not confirmed after label click
bugs.actual: click reported failure, no visible queue; Execute ran with 0 orders

suggestions.what: One Next month per month: skip the second one or merge result and paper
Let me pick a big goal on the title in plain words ("stop a war") instead of seed codes and flashpoint jargon
Keep Map mode when I chose it
Vary months 5-12 so Accept all does not make it autopilot

delight: Seed code worked first try and opened right on a crisis
Month 1 Accept cabinet pick then Execute then the big -10 result card with a quote: satisfying within 2 minutes (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-03/shots/olivia-laptop/007-r1.png)

fun.reason: Quick wins and the big result cards are fun, but from month 4 it was Accept all, Execute, Next, Next.

clarity.reason: I always knew the next button; I did not understand most names or why numbers moved.

visual.reason: Globe, illustrated scenes and cards look like a real game, not a form.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Cards and stamps feel gamey; the small grey jargon text and drawers feel like work.

agency.reason: Never blocked, but the staff did most choices so I did not feel clever.

realism.reason: Cannot judge; the Iran war ending by itself felt odd.

replay.reason: Maybe one more with a different country, not the same.

recommend.reason: I would send it to a friend who likes news; not to one who plays Candy Crush.

verbatim: Okay that first month was actually fun. Then I pressed the same two buttons nine times and a war I never touched ended by itself.
